title: Portside Catering
dek: Brand identity for Portside, a catering business offering platters and grazing tables: logo, colour and type system, and printed menu labels.
problem: Portside needed an identity it could apply across packaging and event materials, including editable labels for individual dishes.
approach: The identity pairs a circular Portside Catering lockup with a hand-drawn wave pattern, set in Montserrat with a two-colour palette of cream and slate blue defined in the brand guide.
The system extends to sheets of editable menu labels, each carrying the logo, the dish name and the web address, so the client could produce labels for each item on the menu.
leadership: Directed the identity and its applications through agency:collective.
gallery: Brand guide: wordmark, pattern, colour and typeface
